> **Redact before pasting.** Crash reports and server logs carry player names,
> UUIDs, IP addresses and local paths — other people's data as well as your own.

> **Check whose crash it is first.** If `ravencoin` appears nowhere in the stack
> trace, the report almost certainly belongs to another mod's tracker. Open it
> here anyway if the crash only happens with RavenCoin installed.

## What were you doing?

The more precise, the better — "opened the settings screen of a shop with an
empty chest behind it" beats "was playing".

## Does it happen every time?

- [ ] Every time, and I can reproduce it on demand
- [ ] Sometimes
- [ ] Once so far

## Does it happen with RavenCoin alone?

- [ ] Yes — reproduced with only RavenCoin and NeoForge installed
- [ ] No — it needs another mod present (name it below)
- [ ] Not tested

## Where

- [ ] Client
- [ ] Dedicated server
- [ ] Singleplayer / integrated server

## Environment

| Field             | Value                                 |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| RavenCoin version | e.g. 0.1.0-beta.1 (from the jar name) |
| Minecraft version | e.g. 1.21.1                           |
| NeoForge version  | e.g. 21.1.248                         |
| LuckPerms         | installed (version) / not installed   |
| Other mods        | the whole list, or a link to the pack |

## Crash report

<!-- crash-reports/crash-<date>.txt, or the stack trace from logs/latest.log.
     Paste the whole thing — the first line is rarely the useful one. -->

```
paste the crash report here
```

## Did anything survive it?

If the crash happened during a transaction, say what the player and the
container held once the server came back up.
